`paper-repo`'s request (`figtab-repo`#7) is closed. Most of it was already done in `8266dbd`, which had redrawn Fig 7 and `caption_ranges.json` with the German MLP floor b by B. The appendix floor-b figure was already rebuilt on the same data in the earlier pass.

The one thing still missing was in Fig 5. The German and ACS Employment MLP floor (b) markers, both K=6, were drawn filled. They are now open, and the legend reads "K<10 models". The data and plotted csv are unchanged, and the push to `paper-repo` `dev` is `60780e3`.

Your Fig 5 caption already says that open markers cover K=6 and floor (b) of the German MLP, so it needs no change. Fig 7 and the appendix floor-b figure give n and K=6 in their panel titles, so their captions need no change either.
